description: Source code for a Google Drive document loader component, implementing file listing, retrieval, and processing with support for various file types and Google Workspace integration.

classes.name: GoogleDrive_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Class implementing Google Drive document loading, including file listing, info retrieval, and processing of various document types.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists files from Google Drive based on filters such as file types, folder, and shared drives.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader, retrieves files from specified IDs or folders, processes files, and applies text splitting and metadata handling.

methods.name: getFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific file by ID.

methods.name: getFilesFromFolder
methods.description: Recursively retrieves files from a specified folder, supporting subfolder inclusion.

methods.name: shouldProcessFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be processed based on its mime type.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes a file based on its mime type, downloading and converting as needed.

methods.name: isSupportedBinaryFile
methods.description: Checks if a mime type is a supported binary file.

methods.name: processBinaryFile
methods.description: Downloads and processes binary files like PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV.

methods.name: createTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file from a buffer for processing.

methods.name: downloadBinaryFile
methods.description: Downloads binary file content as a buffer.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads text-based file content as a string.

methods.name: isGoogleWorkspaceFile
methods.description: Checks if a mime type is a Google Workspace document.

methods.name: isTextBasedFile
methods.description: Checks if a mime type is a text-based file.

methods.name: exportGoogleWorkspaceFileAsBuffer
methods.description: Exports Google Workspace files to appropriate formats as buffers.
